# coolify_cloud_init_script (Resource)

Manages a Coolify team cloud-init script. Requires Coolify >= v4.3.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_cloud_init_script" "bootstrap" {
  name   = "bootstrap"
  script = <<-EOT
    #cloud-config
    packages:
      - curl
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Script name.
- `script` (String) Cloud-init YAML. Coolify validates it as YAML.

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String) Script UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coolify_cloud_init_script.bootstrap <script-uuid>
```
